# Bounded seed and independent exception formal

An owned provider retains T extends CharSequence in its direct input and result,
while an independent X extends Throwable owns Supplier<X> and throws X. Four
frozen callers compare 96 cases twice for source and SDK providers, including
mutable input identity, opaque or null results, late subtype casts, lazy/null
suppliers, original casts, partial writes and exact checked/runtime/Error identity.
Every recovered unit and original metadata entry is compiled and audited. Six
wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard observation and
scope. Only owned in-memory code executes.
